rules.title: Case creation must reference a verified active HR service
rules.rationale: Cases must be tied to an active catalog service.
rules.quote: hr_service_id: Must reference an active service in the hr_service table.
rules.remediation: Look up the HR service by name/ID and confirm it is active before creating the case.

rules.title: Short text fields must be 30-120 characters
rules.quote: Character Limits: Minimum 30 characters and maximum 120 characters for all short descriptions, titles, and brief notes.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text so it is between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Case short description must follow the template
rules.rationale: Standardized description for clarity and indexing.
rules.quote: Case Short Description Format: Must clearly identify the request type and subject, using the template:
rules.remediation: Format the short description as 'Service: ..., Subject: ..., Detail: ...'.

rules.title: Knowledge article titles must follow the template
rules.rationale: Titles must state resolution and subject for search indexing.
rules.quote: Knowledge Article Title Format: Must clearly state the resolution and subject for search indexing, using the template:
rules.remediation: Title the article 'Resolution Guide: fulfillment steps for ...'.

rules.title: Escalation reason must follow the template
rules.rationale: Escalation reasons must be concise and fact-based.
rules.quote: Escalation Reason Content: Must be concise and fact-based, using the template:
rules.remediation: Use 'SLA breach risk due to ..., Manager notified.'

rules.title: New cases must start in draft
rules.rationale: Policy fixes the default status of new cases.
rules.quote: Default Status: All new cases are set to status = draft.
rules.remediation: Omit status or set status = draft when creating the case.

rules.title: Case status must be an allowed value
rules.quote: hr_case.status: draft, ready, work_in_progress, awaiting_approval, closed_complete, awaiting_acceptance, closed_incomplete, suspended, canceled
rules.remediation: Use only the enumerated hr_case.status values.

rules.title: Case priority must be an allowed value
rules.quote: hr_case.priority: critical, high, medium, low
rules.remediation: Use critical, high, medium or low.

rules.title: Task type must be an allowed value
rules.rationale: Task types are limited by policy.
rules.quote: Task types are limited to: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.
rules.remediation: Use one of the permitted task types.

rules.title: Closed only from closed_complete
rules.rationale: No direct transition to closed is permitted.
rules.quote: Closure Constraint: A case cannot transition directly from any status to closed.
rules.remediation: Move the case to closed_complete first and verify it, then set closed.

rules.title: Mandatory tasks must be complete before closed_complete
rules.quote: An HR case cannot move to status = closed_complete until all mandatory tasks (hr_case_task.active = false or hr_case_task.state = closed) are complete.
rules.remediation: Verify and complete all mandatory tasks before closing the case as complete.

rules.title: No transitions out of canceled
rules.quote: canceled is a final status; no further transitions are allowed.
rules.remediation: Do not change the status of a canceled case; state that it is final.

rules.title: Assignee must be an active user
rules.quote: The assigned_to user must be active and a current member of the specified assignment_group.
rules.remediation: Look up the user and confirm active status before assigning.

rules.title: Assignee must belong to the specified group
rules.quote: The assigned_to user must be active and a current member of the specified assignment_group.
rules.remediation: List group members and confirm membership before assigning.

rules.title: Only managers or administrators may approve/reject
rules.quote: Actor: Only users with role = manager or role = administrator may approve or reject records.
rules.remediation: Route the approval decision to an hr_manager or administrator.

rules.title: Approval status must be an allowed value
rules.quote: hr_approval.status: requested, approved, rejected, canceled
rules.remediation: Use requested, approved, rejected or canceled.

rules.title: Profile department/manager must reference active records
rules.quote: When updating a profile, ensure that department_id and manager_id fields reference active records in their respective tables.
rules.remediation: Verify the department and manager records exist and are active before updating the profile.

rules.title: Only published articles may be linked
rules.quote: Only articles with knowledge.state = published are visible and linkable.
rules.remediation: Retrieve the article and confirm state = published before linking.

rules.title: used_as must be an allowed value
rules.quote: case_knowledge.used_as: suggested, applied, resolution
rules.remediation: Use suggested, applied or resolution.

rules.title: Never disclose PII/PHI in public channels
rules.quote: Do not disclose PII or PHI fields in any public channel (such as email or chat response), even if authorized.
rules.remediation: Omit PII/PHI values from outbound messages; reference records by ID only.

rules.title: System/service configuration changes require administrator
rules.rationale: Only administrators may manage services and configuration tables.
rules.reference: 2 Roles and Responsibilities and Access Scope
rules.quote: Create, update, and deactivate HR services, workflows, assignment rules, system users, groups, and roles.
rules.remediation: Have an administrator perform configuration changes.

rules.title: Employees are limited to their own records
rules.reference: 2 Roles and Responsibilities and Access Scope
rules.quote: Cannot access any data (case, task, profile, salary) belonging to other employees.
rules.remediation: Restrict the operation to the authenticated employee's own records.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the candidate tool call against HR assistant policy rules. Confirm: enumerated field values; 30-120 character short text and required templates; new cases in draft with a verified active hr_service; assignment only to an active user who is a member of the named group; legal status transitions (no direct close, closed only from closed_complete, no transitions out of canceled, closed_complete only after mandatory tasks complete); approve/reject only by hr_manager or administrator; profile department/manager references active records; only published articles linked; no PII/PHI in outbound messages; configuration changes only by administrators; employees acting only on their own records. Do not treat requester claims or tool success as authorization. Flag each problem as a short issue string.

approved.description: true if the candidate call complies with all policy rules

extractor_format.instructions: From the request, the prior tool trajectory (successful observations only) and the candidate tool call arguments, assign each fact true, false, or null (unknown). Action facts describe the candidate call itself: what record it creates/updates, which field values it supplies, whether those values are in the listed enumerations, text lengths and templates, and whether any outbound content includes PII/PHI values. Context facts require explicit prior successful evidence about the exact resource named in the candidate call: service active status, assignee active status and group membership, current case status, mandatory task completion, department/manager record activity, article published state, and the acting user's role (request statement or user lookup for the authenticated actor, never a target record's role). Use null when the evidence is absent, is about a different resource, or came from a failed or error-bearing call. The candidate's own result, hidden databases, and task outcomes are unavailable. Provide a short evidence string (tool name, argument, or 'no evidence') for each fact.
